 Valencia name 24 for Real Madrid visit, Copete returns as Javier Aguirre omits Sato 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Mestalla is set for Real Madrid as Valencia, led by Javier Aguirre, chase their first home win of the season. According to Superdeporte, it is also their last meeting with Madrid at this venue and the coach expects a gala atmosphere.
 Aguirre has named 24 players, with Copete the standout inclusion. The centre-back has been inactive since February due to a meniscus tear in his left knee, and after nine months of recovery he is available again.
 OneFootball Videos
 He bolsters a defence that includes Diakhaby, Tárrega and De Jaas. Pepelu has also stepped in as reliable cover if required.
 Sato is the player omitted for technical reasons. He has not featured since Aguirre accepted the challenge of taking over at Valencia.
 He had already remained on the bench during the transition under Óscar Sánchez, and this marks his first non-selection under the Mexican coach.
 Source: Superdeporte
